features.name: duration
features.label: Duration
features.description: Length of the connection in seconds.

features.name: protocol_type
features.label: Protocol type
features.description: Transport protocol of the connection.

features.name: service
features.label: Service
features.description: Network service on the destination (for example http, ftp).

features.name: src_bytes
features.label: Source bytes
features.description: Bytes sent from source to destination.

features.name: dst_bytes
features.label: Destination bytes
features.description: Bytes sent from destination to source.

features.name: land
features.label: Land
features.description: 1 if the connection is from and to the same host and port.

features.name: wrong_fragment
features.label: Wrong fragment
features.description: Number of wrong fragments.

features.name: urgent
features.label: Urgent
features.description: Number of urgent packets.

features.name: hot
features.label: Hot
features.description: Number of 'hot' indicators (access to system directories, program execution).

features.name: num_failed_logins
features.label: Number of failed logins
features.description: Number of failed login attempts.

features.name: logged_in
features.label: Logged in
features.description: 1 if the login succeeded.

features.name: num_compromised
features.label: Number of compromised
features.description: Number of compromised conditions.

features.name: root_shell
features.label: Root shell
features.description: 1 if a root shell was obtained.

features.name: su_attempted
features.label: Su attempted
features.description: Set if a 'su root' command was attempted.

features.name: num_file_creations
features.label: Number of file creations
features.description: Number of file creation operations.

features.name: num_shells
features.label: Number of shells
features.description: Number of shell prompts.

features.name: num_access_files
features.label: Number of access files
features.description: Number of operations on access control files.

features.name: is_host_login
features.label: Is host login
features.description: 1 if the login belongs to the 'hot' list (root or admin).

features.name: is_guest_login
features.label: Is guest login
features.description: 1 if the login is a guest login.

features.name: count
features.label: Count
features.description: Connections to the same host as this one in the past 2 seconds.

features.name: srv_count
features.label: Service count
features.description: Connections to the same service as this one in the past 2 seconds.

features.name: serror_rate
features.label: SYN-error rate
features.description: Fraction of those connections with SYN errors.

features.name: rerror_rate
features.label: REJ-error rate
features.description: Fraction of those connections with REJ errors.

features.name: same_srv_rate
features.label: Same service rate
features.description: Fraction of those connections to the same service.

features.name: diff_srv_rate
features.label: Different service rate
features.description: Fraction of those connections to different services.

features.name: srv_diff_host_rate
features.label: Service different host rate
features.description: Fraction of same-service connections going to different hosts.

features.name: dst_host_count
features.label: Destination host count
features.description: Connections to the same destination host (past 100 connections).

features.name: dst_host_srv_count
features.label: Destination host service count
features.description: Connections to the same destination host and service (past 100).

features.name: dst_host_diff_srv_rate
features.label: Destination host different service rate
features.description: Fraction of connections to the destination host using different services.

features.name: dst_host_same_src_port_rate
features.label: Destination host same source port rate
features.description: Fraction of connections to the destination host from the same source port.

features.name: dst_host_srv_diff_host_rate
features.label: Destination host service different host rate
features.description: Fraction of same-service connections going to different hosts.

features.name: dst_host_serror_rate
features.label: Destination host SYN-error rate
features.description: Fraction of connections to the destination host with SYN errors.

features.name: dst_host_rerror_rate
features.label: Destination host REJ-error rate
features.description: Fraction of connections to the destination host with REJ errors.

features.name: dst_host_srv_rerror_rate
features.label: Destination host service REJ-error rate
features.description: Fraction of same-service connections to the destination host with REJ errors.
